svg.text: Arduino Uno R4 Ethernet Sensor Node — Wiring Diagram
Indoor installation (closed wooden shelter) with outdoor sensors at 2–3 m

g.text: Pass-through headers (I2C, D2, D3, A0 available)
10/100 Mbps — connects Arduino to indoor network
Qwiic Daisy-Chain: A4/A5 → Adapter → LTC4311 → (2–3 m through wall) → BME280
D2 (INT0) ← Rain | D3 (INT1) ← Anemo | A0 ← Vane | A4/A5 (SDA/SCL) ← BME280 | D10–D13 (SPI) ← W5500
